Convert to mpg: 8.2 L per 100 km. 1 gallon = 3.785 L. 100 km = 62.137 miles. So consumption per mile: 8.2 L / 62.137 mi = 0.132 L/mi. Convert to mpg: 1 gallon = 3.785 L, so 1 mile uses 0.132 L, so gallons per mile = 0.132 / 3.785 = 0.0349 gallons per mile. So mpg = 1 / 0.0349 = 28.66 mpg. So 10 gallons gives range: 10 * 28.66 = 286.6 miles. Distance 750 miles > 286.6, so need to refuel. How much? Need 750 miles / 28.66 mpg = 26.18 gallons. Tank capacity 50 gallons, currently 10, so need about 16.18 gallons to fill to full. But maybe just enough to reach destination: 26.18 gallons total, so need 16.18 gallons. We can call fillFuelTank with fuelAmount 16.18. But maybe better to find nearest tire shop? Actually we need fuel. There's function fillFuelTank. Let's call it.")
